points.description: First valid environmental problem of open dumping stated, e.g. leachate generation/groundwater or water contamination, GHG/methane release from anaerobic decomposition, odour, or insect/rodent infestation causing public health issues.
points.partial_credit: Half mark if the problem is vague (e.g. just 'pollution' or 'health problems') or has a minor error.

points.description: A second, different valid environmental problem from the same set (leachate, GHG release, odour, insect/rodent infestation and public health issues).
points.partial_credit: Half mark if the problem is vague (e.g. just 'pollution' or 'health problems') or has a minor error.

rubric.notes: Full marks for two different valid problems, such as leachate, GHG/methane release, odour, or insects/rodents causing health issues. Synonyms are fine (e.g. 'groundwater contamination by liquid from waste' for leachate). Give part marks for vague answers, and no marks for wrong or repeated items. Two wordings of the same problem count once.
